item.title: Are Tooltips UX or Confessions?
item.content:encoded:
Every tooltip is a small admission

The screen didn’t explain itself, so a little box has to.

  • Labels that need help
  • Icons nobody reads

Good design & good copy remove most of them.

Are Tooltips UX or Confessions? was originally published in Coinmonks on Medium, where people are continuing the conversation by highlighting and responding to this story.
